review_protocol.usable_item: The cited page supports the keyed option with necessary conditions; the stem stands alone; no answer-hint translation, unresolved reference or missing formula; at least one meaningful alternative requires a conceptual distinction.
review_protocol.chapter_gate: At least two usable questions per chapter, checked individually. No substitution of a different chapter for an empty result.
review_protocol.batch_gate: Every chapter meets its gate and every generated item has a verified source.
review_protocol.not_measured: Human learning gains, broad mastery and independent teacher assessment.
